hasil.hook: Have you ever felt like you're falling right as you drift off to sleep?

naskah.narasi: Have you ever felt like you're falling right as you drift off to sleep?
naskah.teks_layar: [Top frame: 'by Agung'] WHY DO YOU FEEL LIKE FALLING? (Text effect: Kinetic Glitch in)

naskah.narasi: Your body suddenly twitches, snapping you wide awake. This weird event is called a hypnic jerk.
naskah.teks_layar: [Top frame: 'by Agung'] THE HYPNIC JERK! (Text effect: Bouncing Pop-up)

naskah.narasi: It happens when your muscles relax so deeply that your brain misinterprets the signal, thinking you're falling.
naskah.teks_layar: [Top frame: 'by Agung'] Brain gets confused! (Text effect: Smooth Slide-in with Glow)

naskah.narasi: To protect you, your brain shoots a sudden burst of electrical signals to shock your body back awake.
naskah.teks_layar: [Top frame: 'by Agung'] BRAIN EMERGENCY SIGNAL ⚡ (Text effect: Neon Flash Pulse)

naskah.narasi: Scientists believe it's an ancient survival instinct passed down from ancestors who slept high in trees.
naskah.teks_layar: [Top frame: 'by Agung'] Ancient Survival Instinct (Text effect: Typewriter Animation)

naskah.narasi: So your brain is basically trying to save your life while you rest! How often does this happen to you?
naskah.teks_layar: [Top frame: 'by Agung'] How often does this happen to you? (Text effect: Zoom-in Wave)

hasil.cta: How often do you experience this falling sensation? Tell me in the comments!
